description: Sakinah's Adjective Odyssey — free offline-rendered AI voice samples, generated once and reused

lines.text: Hello Sakinah! Welcome to our adjective adventure. Listen, learn, and have fun!
Big. Bigger. The elephant is bigger than the mouse.
Beautiful. More beautiful. The butterfly is more beautiful than the ant.
Remember: We use than when we compare two things.
Less. The turtle is less noisy than the lion.
